what: Fault injection into the shared tables and functions of the unified model (fastcalc). For each fault: the units whose public results change against the run without the fault.
data_statement: SYNTHETIC_FICTIONAL data only. Not evidence about real buildings or about any other tool.

comparison.changed: a leaf differs by more than the tolerance, is missing, or is new
comparison.a_changed_value: a leaf of type float differs (counts, flags and texts do not count here)
comparison.failing_against_reference: the rule of the exactness check (leaves the totals-only mode leaves out are ignored in that mode)

K1.tables:scaled.perturbation: every activity of every table x 1.5

K1.tables:key_removed.perturbation: the first factor key of every table removed

K2.period_groups:scaled.perturbation: lines, repair lines and masses of every period group x 1.5

K2.periodic_years.perturbation: every event one year earlier (not before year 1)

K3.grid_segments.perturbation: every descriptor reported as not well formed

K3._values.perturbation: every yearly value of an annual quantity x 1.5

K3._purchased_series.perturbation: yearly purchase, emission and their sum x 1.5

K4.device_table:scaled.perturbation: every charge x GWP entry x 1.5

K5.indicator:scaled.perturbation: result x 1.5 (cancels in a ratio of two indicators)

K5.indicator:stage_left_out.perturbation: the first stage of the subset left out

K7.Resolver.convert:scaled.perturbation: every multiplier between different units x 1.5

K7.Resolver.convert:missing.perturbation: every conversion between different units reported missing

K7.recipes:mass_scaled.perturbation: the mass summed per composition x 1.5

K7.licence_findings.perturbation: every factor id entered as unlicensed (after the licence gate has reported)

other.last_weight.perturbation: weight of the last study year x 0.5

direct_outputs.definition: a public leaf of the unit IS the value a shared function returned (marked float or int, unchanged by any arithmetic). A lower bound of 'produced by the shared function': sums of such values and verdicts do not show up here.

not_marked.K6._within, other._left_out, other._same: they return a verdict (bool), which cannot carry a mark
not_marked.K4._add_leak_series: it adds to a list and returns nothing
not_marked.K3.grid_segments, K2.event_year: their values only enter other shared functions (segment_moments / explicit_years)

tables.note: entries of the tables the unified model returns (summed over the scenarios and both modes); a pseudo key marks a line whose activity is already an emission (factor 1)

not_broken.fastcalc.closed_forms.inside: a falsified verdict puts events outside the study years and the yearly outputs fail with an index error instead of a changed value
not_broken.fastcalc.engine.Resolver.triples: a memo that is filled and read inside the aggregation; its content is the result of Resolver.record and Resolver.convert, which are broken instead
not_broken.fastcalc.engine.STAGE_TABLES, STAGE_UPST: constants that say which table belongs to which stage; not a computation

notes: Sensitivity is necessary for membership, not sufficient: a unit downstream of a shared object reacts too.

A table fault is applied to the proposal between aggregate and finish. The baseline of the comparison (SUM-08) is aggregated inside finish and is not touched by it; a function fault acts on the baseline as well.
In full-output mode the per-row lists were multiplied row by row during the aggregation, so a table fault changes a unit's value and leaves its per-row list as it was.
units[...].flag_only_in_totals: the unit returns no float in totals-only mode on any scenario of the set (only counts, flags or texts).
K7.licence_findings is not the resolution table: it is the per-factor finding of the licence gate, which the check of the used factors reads again.
